company.shortDescription: Growdash is a business intelligence and analytics tool built specifically for restaurants to support profitable growth strategic decisions.
company.description: Growdash is a business intelligence and analytics tool built specifically for restaurants to support profitable growth strategic decisions across online sales channels. GrowDash is a Dubai-based restaurant technology and AI-driven SaaS company that helps restaurants optimize delivery operations, online advertising, and growth across third-party food delivery platforms. Founded in 2022 by former Talabat leaders Sean Trevaskis and Enver Sorkun, the company develops intelligent analytics and automation tools designed to simplify restaurant performance management in the digital delivery economy. Its flagship AI delivery manager, Aisha, provides real-time insights, campaign optimization, automated recommendations, reporting, and operational analytics that help restaurants improve profitability, marketing efficiency, and customer engagement.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,851,388, or 71.17% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,277,134 to $13,062,043, a 2.08x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
